0022600089.text: Both the Utah Jazz and the Memphis Grizzlies open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Jazz on the road. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot), while Blake Hinson (hip), Kyle Filipowski (back) and Trey Alexander (knee) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions. For Memphis, Isaiah Stewart (ankle) is out, and GG Jackson (ankle), Jerami Grant (soreness, undisclosed) and Micah Peavy (ankle) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Jazz won the last meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives Utah a 55% chance to win.
